h1: Autonomous AI Agents for Marshall Islands
sub: Run persistent cloud computers that manage maritime logistics, global research, and automated operations across Pacific time zones even when your phone is offline.
audience: Maritime logistics coordinators, commercial fisheries liaisons, shipping agents, environmental grant writers, and remote contractors working from Majuro, Ebeye, and beyond.
manifesto: In an island nation spanning vast Pacific waters, Ceyo gives you round-the-clock autonomous cloud computers that monitor global markets, manage maritime trade, and keep critical workflows moving even when connectivity drops.

uses.d: Your agent autonomously monitors inbound freight manifests through Majuro port, verifies customs documentation, and alerts team channels on Slack.
Automate daily catch data entry, reconcile transshipment sheets in Google Sheets, and compile regional fishery compliance summaries while you sleep.
Direct web-browsing bots to track international climate funding portals, extract technical criteria into Notion, and draft formal proposals.
Coordinate seamlessly with partners in Honolulu, Tokyo, and Washington without waking up at midnight, using scheduled email and Telegram workflows.
Collect infrastructure and water reservoir metrics, process status tables with cloud Python scripts, and distribute clean weekly dashboards.
Manage cross-border contractor settlements and digital remittances reliably using the agent's built-in cryptographic wallet and scheduled triggers.

steps.d: Select Plus, Pro, or Ultra to spin up your dedicated, isolated cloud computer instantly.
Link Telegram, Gmail, Google Sheets, or your CRM to integrate your agent into existing workflows.
Assign web research, document parsing, or coding pipelines that run 24/7 without manual intervention.

chapters.d: While Majuro wakes up, your Ceyo bot scrapes maritime tracking portals for vessel ETA updates and formats a crisp status report in Telegram. You review container arrivals over breakfast without opening dozens of slow shipping sites.

Your agent pulls customs declarations from Gmail, cross-references tariff codes, and updates a shared Google Sheet automatically. It runs isolated Python scripts in its dedicated cloud computer to validate figures before sending them to colleagues.

Inside a Telegram group chat, your research agent and financial bot collaborate to summarize regional maritime fuel surcharges. They synthesize a detailed market forecast document, complete with charts, ready for stakeholders.

Even after you disconnect and atoll internet speeds fluctuate, your cloud computer stays online around the clock. It monitors international trade announcements, processes heavy scraping tasks, and prepares tomorrow's operational queue.

faq.q: How much does Ceyo cost and is there a free trial?
faq.a: Ceyo offers three subscription tiers: Plus ($20/month), Pro ($60/month), and Ultra ($120/month). Every plan begins with a 3-day free trial providing up to 1,000,000 tokens per day. A payment card is linked at registration and is only billed when the trial completes unless cancelled beforehand.

faq.q: Does Ceyo continue working when local internet cuts out?
faq.a: Yes. Every Ceyo agent operates on its own dedicated cloud virtual computer that runs 24 hours a day, 7 days a week. It continues web browsing, running code, and executing tasks regardless of your local internet connection or phone battery status.

faq.q: Can I interact with my Ceyo bots through Telegram?
faq.a: Yes. Ceyo integrates natively with Telegram, allowing you to converse with individual personal bots or assemble teams of specialized bots in group chats. You can assign tasks, receive scheduled alerts, and review files straight from your mobile messenger.

faq.q: What languages do Ceyo agents support?
faq.a: Ceyo supports fluent communication, translation, and text analysis in English, Marshallese, and dozens of other international languages. You can ask your bot to parse complex English regulatory documents and draft summaries adapted to local team requirements.

faq.q: How secure is my data on Ceyo's cloud computer?
faq.a: Each bot operates inside a completely isolated sandbox environment with its own filesystem, memory, and credentials. Your browsing sessions, cloud storage tokens, and connected workspace accounts remain strictly separated and protected from other users.
